strengths.text: A period long-term manual BRZ test records real maintenance and wear observations for one car. It cannot establish platform failure rates.

driving.text: The 2.4 fills in the old midrange gap, and the small chassis stays approachable. The tested manual encourages involvement on ordinary roads.

styling.text: The low hood, rounder nose and compact tail form a coherent coupe.

character.enthusiastAppeal: An accessible rear-drive chassis and modest size put the focus on control feedback.
